IMP_CAMERAMGR.content:
SWC implementation of the cameraMgr application component. Realizes
the ``cameraMgr_InternalBehavior`` providing camera hardware control,
image acquisition, and state reporting via the canInfoState port.
IMP_CAMERAMGR.title: cameraMgr_Implementation

IMP_DISTANCECTRL.content:
SWC implementation of the distanceCtrl application component. Realizes
the ``distanceCtrl_InternalBehavior`` providing sensor fusion, tiger
classification, and distance-based detection within the 50 m radius.
IMP_DISTANCECTRL.title: distanceCtrl_Implementation

IMP_MYSERVICECOMPONENT.content:
SWC implementation of the myServiceComponent service component.
Realizes the ``myServiceComponent_InternalBehavior`` providing
audible alarm activation and visual display warning output.
IMP_MYSERVICECOMPONENT.title: myServiceComponent_Implementation

IMP_SENSORINPUT.content:
SWC implementation of the sensorInput ECU abstraction component.
Realizes the ``sensorInput_InternalBehavior`` providing
hardware-independent access to camera, LiDAR, and infrared sensors
via the myCSPort client-server interface.
IMP_SENSORINPUT.title: sensorInput_Implementation

IMP_STATEM.content:
SWC implementation of the stateM application component. Realizes the
``stateM_InternalBehavior`` providing the central detection lifecycle
state machine, coordinating sensor activation and warning triggers.
IMP_STATEM.title: stateM_Implementation

SP_CAMERACMP.content:
Composition SWC encapsulating the camera subsystem. Contains the
``cameraMgr`` prototype and exposes delegation connectors: ``camCmd``
R-port (receives commands from stateM) and ``camState`` P-port
(provides camera status to distanceCtrl).
SP_CAMERACMP.title: CameraCmp — Camera Subsystem Composition

SP_CAMERAMGR.content:
Application SWC responsible for camera hardware control. Receives
commands via the ``myIwithinComp`` R-port and publishes camera state
via the ``canInfoState`` P-port. Manages camera initialization,
image acquisition, and operational mode switching.
SP_CAMERAMGR.title: cameraMgr — Camera Manager

SP_DISTANCECTRL.content:
Application SWC implementing the core detection and distance control
algorithm. Receives distance commands via ``distanceCmd`` R-port from
stateM, sensor data via ``myCSPort`` R-port from sensorInput, and
camera state via ``camState`` R-port from CameraCmp. Fuses sensor
data and classifies detected objects.
SP_DISTANCECTRL.title: distanceCtrl — Distance Control

SP_MYCOMPOSITION.content:
Top-level AUTOSAR composition that integrates all SWC prototypes
(distanceCtrl, stateM, sensorInput, CameraCmp) and defines the assembly
connectors between them. Responsible for the overall data flow from
sensor acquisition through detection to warning output.
SP_MYCOMPOSITION.title: myComposition — System Composition

SP_MYSERVICECOMPONENT.content:
Service SWC responsible for managing the warning output subsystem.
Activates audible alarms and drives the visual display upon receiving
a positive tiger detection event from the state machine.
SP_MYSERVICECOMPONENT.title: myServiceComponent — Warning Service

SP_SENSORINPUT.content:
ECU abstraction SWC that provides a hardware-independent interface to
the physical sensors (camera, LiDAR, infrared). Exposes the ``myCSPort``
P-port (client-server interface) with operations ``myGetSomething`` and
``Operation`` for sensor data retrieval by distanceCtrl.
SP_SENSORINPUT.title: sensorInput — Sensor Input Abstraction

SP_STATEM.content:
Application SWC that implements the central state machine governing the
detection lifecycle. Provides the ``distanceCmd`` P-port (SR interface)
to distanceCtrl and the ``camCmd`` P-port to CameraCmp. Coordinates
sensor activation, detection algorithm triggering, and warning
activation.
SP_STATEM.title: stateM — State Machine Controller

TDS_ALG_001.content:
The system shall implement a detection algorithm that processes fused
sensor data to classify detected objects as tiger or non-tiger. The
algorithm shall achieve the detection rates specified in TDS_SAF_003
and TDS_SAF_004.
TDS_ALG_001.title: Detection Algorithm

TDS_ALG_002.content:
The detection algorithm shall produce a classification result within
500 ms of sensor data acquisition to allow timely warning of personnel.
TDS_ALG_002.title: Detection Latency

TDS_ALG_003.content:
The system shall maintain a false-positive rate of no more than 5 % under
all specified environmental conditions to avoid unnecessary alarm fatigue.
TDS_ALG_003.title: False Positive Rate

TDS_ENV_001.content:
The system shall operate and meet the 98 % detection rate during daytime
under overcast / cloudy sky conditions.
TDS_ENV_001.title: Daytime Cloudy Operation

TDS_ENV_002.content:
The system shall operate and meet the 98 % detection rate during daytime
under direct sunlight conditions.
TDS_ENV_002.title: Daytime Sunny Operation

TDS_ENV_003.content:
The system shall operate and meet the 98 % detection rate during
nighttime conditions (no ambient visible light).
TDS_ENV_003.title: Nighttime Operation

TDS_SAF_001.content:
The Tiger Detection System shall be developed and validated in accordance
with ASIL B as defined by ISO 26262 (adapted for the exploration domain).
All safety-relevant detection functions shall meet ASIL B hardware and
software requirements.
TDS_SAF_001.title: Tiger Detection Safety Integrity Level

TDS_SAF_002.content:
The system shall detect adult tigers within a radius of 50 m around the
exploration group under all specified environmental conditions.
TDS_SAF_002.title: Detection Range

TDS_SAF_003.content:
The system shall detect at least 98 % of adult tigers during daytime
conditions including cloudy skies and direct sunlight.
TDS_SAF_003.title: Daytime Detection Rate

TDS_SAF_004.content:
The system shall detect at least 98 % of adult tigers during nighttime
conditions.
TDS_SAF_004.title: Nighttime Detection Rate

TDS_SEN_001.content:
The system shall include at least one camera sensor capable of capturing
visual imagery in the visible spectrum with sufficient resolution to
identify adult tigers at distances up to 50 m during daytime (cloudy and
sunny conditions).
TDS_SEN_001.title: Camera Sensor

TDS_SEN_002.content:
The system shall include a LiDAR sensor capable of detecting objects and
providing 3D point-cloud data within a 50 m radius. The LiDAR shall
operate independently of ambient light conditions.
TDS_SEN_002.title: LiDAR Sensor

TDS_SEN_003.content:
The system shall include an infrared (thermal) sensor capable of detecting
the heat signature of adult tigers at distances up to 50 m. The infrared
sensor shall be the primary detection modality during nighttime operation.
TDS_SEN_003.title: Infrared Sensor

TDS_SEN_004.content:
The system shall fuse data from camera, LiDAR, and infrared sensors to
improve detection reliability and reduce false-positive and false-negative
rates compared to any single sensor operating alone.
TDS_SEN_004.title: Sensor Fusion

TDS_WRN_001.content:
Upon positive tiger detection the system shall activate both audible and
visual warnings simultaneously within 1 s of the detection event.
TDS_WRN_001.title: Warning Activation

TDS_WRN_002.content:
The system shall emit an audible alarm of at least 85 dB(A) at 1 m
distance to ensure personnel are alerted even in noisy outdoor
environments.
TDS_WRN_002.title: Audible Warning

TDS_WRN_003.content:
The system shall display a clear warning message on a dedicated display
indicating the detection of a tiger, including the estimated direction
and approximate distance.
TDS_WRN_003.title: Visual Warning Display

arch.description: Mapping of uml key to uml content.

constraints.description: List of constraint names, which are defined for this need.

constraints_error.description: An error message set if any constraint failed, and `error_message` field is set in config.

constraints_passed.description: True if all constraints passed, False if any failed, None if not yet checked.

constraints_results.description: Mapping of constraint name, to check name, to result, None if not yet checked.

content.description: The main content of the need.

docname.description: Name of the document where the need is defined (None if external).

doctype.description: The markup type of the content, denoted by the suffix of the source file, e.g. '.rst'.

external_css.description: CSS class name, added to the external reference.

external_url.description: URL of the need, if it is an external need.

has_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list.

has_forbidden_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list, and the link type does not allow dead links.

is_external.description: If true, no node is created and need is referencing external url.

is_import.description: If true, the need was derived from an import.

is_modified.description: Whether the need was modified by needextend.

jinja_content.description: Whether the content was pre-processed by jinja.

layout.description: Key of the layout, which is used to render the need.

lineno.description: Line number where the need is defined (None if external).

parts.description: Mapping of parts, a.k.a. sub-needs, IDs to data that overrides the need's data

post_template.description: The template key, if the post_content was created from a jinja template.

pre_template.description: The template key, if the pre_content was created from a jinja template.

safety_level.description: ASIL classification (A, B, C, D or QM)

signature.description: Derived from a docutils desc_name node.

style.description: Comma-separated list of CSS classes (all appended by `needs_style_`).

sw_component_name.description: AUTOSAR SWC short name from the arxml model

template.description: The template key, if the content was created from a jinja template.
